name: Acolyte
description:
You've served in a temple or church.
You're trained in Religion Lore or a lore about a faith of your choice.
You are also trained in Crafting, Society or Insight.
You gain the Skilled feat.
You start with 7 gold pieces and a holy symbol.

name: Airship Pilot
description:
You've trained to pilot airships and navigate the skies.
You're trained in Airship Lore and Crafting, Arcana or Survival.
You gain the Expert Pilot feat.
You start with 5 gold pieces and an airship piloting license.

name: Artisan
description:
You have trained in a craft or trade.
You are trained in Crafting.
You are also trained in Sleight of Hand, Society or Persuasion.
You gain the Skilled feat.
You start with a set of artisan's tools and 10 gold pieces.

name: Criminal
description:
You have stayed on the other side of the law.
You are trained in Sleight of Hand or Stealth.
You gain the Sneaky feat.
You are also trained in Underworld Lore.
You start with 8 gold pieces.

name: Entertainer
description:
You make money performing, making music or dancing.
You are trained in Performance.
You are also trained in Acrobatics or Athletics, and in one instrument of your choice.
You gain the Quick Witted feat.
You start with an instrument of your choice and 12 gold pieces.

name: Explorer
description:
You have traveled to many different places and seen many different things.
You are trained in Survival or Nature.
You also become trained in Geography Lore
You gain the Surveyor feat.
You start with a set of traveler's clothes, a bedroll and 8 gold pieces.

name: Hunter
description:
You've learned how to hunt using traditional ranged weapons or runeguns.
You are trained in the Bows, Crossbows or Runeguns weapon groups.
You are also trained in Nature or Survival.
You gain the Marksman feat.
You start with a ranged weapon you are trained in and 10 gold pieces.

name: Labourer
description:
You have been working hard at tough jobs and can take on physical strain other people might not be able to.
You're trained in Athletics.
You are also trained in Crafting, Survival or Brawling.
You gain the Defensive Training feat.
You start with a set of sturdy tools and 5 gold pieces.

name: Medic
description:
You are practiced in the art of healing and curing.
You are trained in Medicine.
You are also trained in Athletics, Crafting, Insight or Sleight of Hand.
You gain the Battlefield Medic feat.
You start with 5 gold pieces and a medicine kit.

name: Noble
description:
You come from a wealthy or influential family.
You are trained in two of Society, Insight, History and Persuasion.
You gain the Skilled feat.
You start with 15 gold pieces and have a seal from your house.

name: Scholar
description:
You have spent years studying a specific field of knowledge.
You are trained in Academia Lore.
You are also trained in Arcana, History or Nature.
You gain the Dedicated Student feat.
You start with a book on your field of study and 5 gold pieces.

name: Soldier
description:
You have trained and fought in an army or militia.
You are trained in Warfare Lore.
You are trained in Athletics or Brawling.
You gain the Army Training feat.
You start with a set of light armor and a martial weapon of your choice (worth at most 10 gold pieces).

name: Spy
description:
You have worked in the shadows, gathering information and secrets.
You are trained in Stealth or Deception.
You learn an additional language of your choice.
You gain the Sneaky feat.
You start with a disguise kit, a forged identity and 10 gold pieces.
